findings.statement: Decoded the owner-provided VICE C64MEM RAM and manually inspected 6502 routines: four-direction joystick port 2 controls, fire bit 16, one-pixel movement increments, 60-room table, initial four reserve lives, projectile pools and six decimal score digits. A new Rust CPU/display/input runtime retains the original RAM instructions and original art instead of estimating per-enemy rules.

handoff: Fixed user's room order/connection complaint in app/. Root cause established with temporary Rust diagnostic: reference_export captured room8 -> actual9 and15 -> actual17 by frame823 (actor interactions moved idle ship through exits); raw room links already matched original RAM, so backgrounds/collision/actors were mislabeled. Removed diagnostic file. Build-time reference_export now patches only its capture machine's four exit handlers $1330/$136F/$13CE/$142D to RTS, asserts active room for every sample and background, emits capturedRoom identity. Regenerated all60 PNGs, collision/actor data and sprite atlas, preserving prior room10 attachments/door settings. README documents fix. Added tests checking all60 identities/directional links directly against original snapshot, distinct formerly duplicated rooms8/9 and15/17, and physically crossing every linked edge with native collision. npm run build and npm test pass all16 including offline bundle smoke. rebuild_check invoked and passed build/screenshot/selftest/credits; mechanics comparison remains incomplete. Checker still selects preserved Rust runtime, not web bundle. Original simulator unchanged; full original mechanics/visual equivalence remains unverified. Standalone web outputs app/index.html and app/dist/index.html rebuilt. No user confirmation needed; task done.
